summary.text: Taylor Wright is the Libertarian Party nominee for Utah's 4th Congressional District. He is an elementary school physical education teacher and longtime football coach who has also worked with adults with special needs.

paragraphs.text: Wright works as a physical education teacher at Ridge View Elementary School in Herriman, Utah, and has coached football at the middle school, high school and college levels.
He has also worked with adults with special needs and hosted a podcast called "Saving Humanity," which the Salt Lake Tribune describes as a self-help podcast.
